comment: Installed version 2.6.13; no source is published and none ever has been, so the record here is the maker's documentation repository plus the installed build. The documentation was read at tag v2.6.13 of github.com/DomiKamu/OhmerPrems, not at the branch head: the head README describes 2.6.13 stable alongside a 2.6.14 alpha, and by then the 6OP-DX module had been renamed DeXtral and given a different manual, so the head documents a module that is not the one installed. At v2.6.13 the repository holds a README and five manuals: FranKe, FroeZe, KlokSpidMkII, Vektor, and a nine-line placeholder for 6OP-DX. KordZ and QuadPercs have no manual anywhere; QuadPercs is described control by control in the README and KordZ is not described at all, so its entry is read out of the module itself. PANEL THEMES, SETTLED ONCE: every module except the KX and VX expanders carries a Model submenu offering six or eight finishes - Creamy or Aluminium, Stage Repro, Cobalt, Absolute Night, Dark, Fort Knox, Oxide, Deepblue and Titanium Signature, the Signature ones with gold jacks, buttons and screws instead of silver. A new module comes up as Absolute Night when Rack's View menu has Use dark panels if available ticked and as Creamy or Aluminium when it does not. It changes nothing but appearance, so under the house rule it gets no line on any of the eleven, and there is no blank panel here to make the exception. Attached expanders take their parent's model and display brightness rather than having their own. EVERY MODULE'S MENU ALSO ENDS IN A GREYED LICENCE LABEL, either License: full version (for everyone) or a Free/Demo line with the limitations in brackets. It is a label rather than an item and gets no menu line, but where a missing licence actually silences or locks the module - FranKe, FroeZe and its two expanders, QuadPercs - that is written as a Note, because it is exactly the thing that makes a module look broken. KlokSpid MkII, KX, KordZ, Vektor, VX and 6OP-DX are free for everyone and have no such limit. ONE MODEL IS HIDDEN: 6OPDX is marked "hidden": true in the installed plugin.json and so is absent from the module browser. Nothing else in the registration hides anything, and the KlokSpid from the separate free Ohmer plugin that was flagged earlier is not this one - the KlokSpid MkII here carries no hidden flag and is listed normally. A FURTHER COMMON SHAPE: FranKe, FroeZe, KlokSpid MkII, Vektor and 6OP-DX are each worked through a large custom display, which in Rack is a single widget with no ParamWidget per element. None of what is on those screens can be reached by clicking for help, so each of those entries carries a Note saying what the screen is for and how it is worked. Where a module also has a physical joystick or a grid of touch cells, the same applies. Read with the census slice at research/help/census/OhmerPrems.json and the panels rendered from the VCV library screenshot service at 400 pixels.
